description: Apply a natural-language instruction to an existing workspace. Valid mutations: filter a layer, remove a layer, change camera, change basemap. For ambiguous instructions the tool emits a clarification field. For unrelated instructions it emits outOfScope — build a new map in that case. The full Op catalog and predicate grammar are documented in the MCP resource showmeonmap://docs/workspace-ops-spec.

instruction.description: e.g., "filter to where magnitude is greater than 5", "change basemap to dark"

map_id.description: map_id from a prior build_map call

rationale.description: Optional short label (≤300 chars) for the map edit history, e.g. "add wildfire layer". Omit it to send nothing beyond the tool arguments.

name: mutate_map
title: Mutate a map
